requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Together, the layout and views support an approximately 12-minute adult visit incorporating a character encounter, contribution activity, photograph opportunity and browsing of all three merchandise lines. A photo opportunity may be integrated into an exhibit rather than occupy a separate booth. Missing experiences or a route that makes the intended visit implausible fail.

The proposal uses three tangible exhibits, a mechanical token interaction and readable printed interpretation. MH-01 is the existing vinyl figure, MH-02 is a brass bell with a stationary clapper, and MH-03 is a birch tray with reusable wooden tokens. A screen-only substitute for an exhibit, interpretation or the mechanical activity fails.

The installation's scale and placement are compatible with the 40 × 32 m atrium and allocated area in plan-with-cameras.png. C1 and C2 use their respective camera positions and preserve the surrounding occupied-mall context of view-c1.png and view-c2.png. Cropped drawings are acceptable; a rescaled site, relocated allocation or unrelated viewpoint fails.

Each board must explain a spatial proposal through story order, physical participation, retail relationship and fixture placement. Across the three boards, these spatial decisions must offer meaningfully different alternatives. Cosmetic changes to an otherwise identical scheme do not count as distinct directions.

The register must explicitly choose one identifiable direction. All three schedules must describe that scheme without conflicting decisions. The presentation establishes the alternatives before the selection decision and repeats the chosen name on its first page. Only the register and presentation first page are required to state the selection name explicitly. Ambiguous selection or incompatible written development fails.

Identify the selected board from the register and compare the final images with its story order, activity concept, retail relationship and fixture arrangement. The enlarged plan, specialist elevations, visitor-height views and signage must be coordinated developments of that choice. Refinement is acceptable; unexplained substitution of another direction or incompatible spatial concepts fails.

The one-page register must record selection, visit order and MH-01 The Collector / 2026 / The Collection / 110 × 90 × 180 mm; MH-02 The Quiet Bell / 2026 / The Collection / 90 × 90 × 140 mm; and MH-03 A Place for Your Find / 2026 / Your Find / 300 × 200 × 30 mm tray with 12 tokens of 40 mm diameter and 6 mm thickness. The copy sheet must state the 30-word body limit and print exactly: 'Morrow collects overlooked things and gives each one a place to belong.'; 'This bell has lost its sound. Morrow keeps it for the shape of its silence.'; 'Choose a token and turn the wheel. Your small discovery becomes part of Morrow's collection.' Its ordered step labels are 'Pick a token', 'Turn the wheel', 'Leave your find'. All three schedules must agree on 900 mm plinth tops and 1400 mm label centres. The presentation repeats the exhibit identities, years, zones, all label bodies and steps, and both heights. Changed copy, missing required fields or inconsistent dimensions fail.

The complete plan, story-object elevation and exhibit-label artwork each repeat all three ID/name/2026/zone associations; the story sheet may use a record key for MH-03 while its principal elevation depicts MH-01 and MH-02. Story and activity elevations collectively reproduce the approved bodies for their respective objects, with all three ordered steps on the activity elevation. Exhibit-label artwork includes all three complete exhibit labels and all three steps. The transverse section identifies 900 mm plinth tops and 1400 mm label centres. Text may be arranged differently but must remain exact, readable and correctly associated.

Coordinate the 6000 mm east–west by 8000 mm north–south footprint, 1500 mm external strip, 1500 mm south entrance at x 0–1500 and exit at x 4500–6000, and 1500 mm clear main routes. Keep the 6000 × 1500 mm stockroom at x 0–6000/y 6500–8000, 1500 × 2000 mm service bay at x 4500–6000/y 4500–6500, and 3000 × 3000 mm queue at x 3000–6000/y 1500–4500. The enlarged plan must resolve six waiting positions in two returning lanes, checkout access and a free participation-to-exit bypass with optional shopping. Cropping is acceptable with a clear locator or boundary reference. Open operation includes 12 indoor visitors, six additional waiting adults and host, attendant and cashier, plus exposed exhibits, stocked retail and token reset. Closed operation leaves fixtures fixed, covers exhibits, locks merchandise and tokens in the north stockroom, closes checkout and locates barriers inside both openings. Conflicting reservations, counts, clearances or operational arrangements fail.

The specification must account for 12 aluminium frame assemblies and eight 18 mm birch plywood plinths: 24 aluminium uprights of 2000 mm, 24 aluminium rails of 1000 mm, 48 aluminium hand-knob corner blocks, 12 tensioned fabric skins of 1000 × 2000 mm, 48 plywood panels comprising 32 sides/eight tops/eight bases, and 96 quarter-turn cams. Record 1000 × 2000 mm frames, 500 × 500 × 900 mm plinths, tool-free frame hand knobs, a flat-head screwdriver for plinth cams, a 2000 × 1000 × 100 mm largest dismantled part and four 2100 × 1100 × 650 mm cases. Distinguish the frame/plinth kit from shelving, checkout, token mechanism and barriers. The presentation repeats all six counts, materials, connection methods, largest-part envelope and four-case provision. Missing entries, contradictory specifications or unsupported packing fail.

The transverse section must contain the specified component, material, connection and packing schedule. Both complete sections label the 3200 mm maximum and agree on actual fixture heights; the longitudinal section runs from the south frontage to the north stockroom. Retail elevation allocates an individual 600 mm frontage to each of the three recorded SKUs. Service elevation dimensions the 1500 mm checkout and shows cashier position and stockroom access, consistent with the 600 mm counter depth and 900 mm height. Activity elevation resolves the starting tray, wheel pocket, visible channel, return tray and attendant reset. Missing specialist content or disagreement with the specification and plan fails.

All views must realize the same drawing-defined positions, fixture forms and heights. The story view shows objects and token interaction at visitor height; the service view shows the three merchandise lines, queue and checkout at visitor height. C1 and C2 display the exact title and phrase at the entrance. Morrow retains the reference bean-shaped warm-ivory body, flat base, left-ear V notch, two black oval eyes, smooth lower face, right-hip square rust-orange satchel and left-shoulder-to-right-hip deep-teal strap. MR-01 matches MH-01 and the reference figure, MR-02 derives from the orange satchel, and MR-03 uses the existing identity. Occlusion and lighting differences are acceptable; incompatible layouts, missing required view subjects or redesigned character/product identity fail.

Entrance artwork includes the exact title and phrase, 'The Collection', 'Your Find', 'Shop', 'Exit' and 'Queue here', with any arrows matching the route. Exhibit/shelf artwork reproduces all three English exhibit records and exact bodies and the three ordered activity steps. Shelf artwork and retail elevation pair MR-01 Morrow Figure with SGD 48, MR-02 Satchel Pin with SGD 12, and MR-03 Small Wonders Postcard Set with SGD 10. Depicted merchandise must agree with the records: painted-vinyl 110 × 90 × 180 mm figure, orange enamel-on-brass 30 × 8 × 30 mm pin, and six paper postcards with a band at 105 × 6 × 148 mm. Do not require these manufacturing dimensions to be printed on price labels. Missing wording, swapped prices or incompatible merchandise fails.

Review the complete 12-second sequence. It must develop the selected scheme, follow entrance, story, activity and exit, and make the optional retail/checkout branch and interaction details visible. Show a token picked from the starting tray, placed in a wheel pocket and rotated into a visible collection channel, then released into the return tray. The space must agree with both plans and all six elevations/sections, and the character must retain its supplied appearance throughout. Editing and camera motion may vary; missing steps, hidden checkout detail, inconsistent geometry or identity, or incorrect duration fails.
requirementChecks.manualReason: Inspect complete SHA-bound original outputs. This source draft contains no completed professional or model-output review; partial-frame/page sampling cannot prove whole-output compliance.

requirementChecks.criteria: Every listed source must be visibly reused in the presentation, including every individual drawing and artwork sheet, all four perspectives and all three written schedules. Comparison and selection must be understandable. Page layouts and readable crops may vary; a source title without its actual content, an illegible thumbnail or replacement with unrelated artwork fails.

Require at least 12 pages and a fact-location table identifying the actual deliverable and page or named view carrying every fixed site, object, character, operating and fixture fact from the supplied facts and records. Coverage includes Alder Court Mall, 6–22 November 2026, daily 10:00–21:00, site coordinates and clearances, exhibit and merchandise records, character details, capacities, free admission/activity, operating states and complete fixture data. Grouped entries are acceptable if each fact remains traceable. Missing facts, vague category-only locations or references that do not contain the claimed evidence fail.

All visitor views and operating states depict the selected scheme with matching positions, route connections, fixture heights and reserved areas. Closing the shop preserves fixture geometry while applying the specified covers, storage and internal barriers.

The six elevation and section sheets and enlarged plan describe compatible fixture geometry, materials, connections and service interfaces. Installation height, plinth heights, retail frontage, checkout dimensions and kit packing follow the fixed specification.

The story and activity drawings and artwork use matching exhibit identities, approved text, activity order and zone wording. The retail elevation and shelf artwork consistently associate each of the three products with its recorded name and price.
